scientific_integrity: Computed finite instances are independent corroboration, not extrapolations to the infinite family. No external independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem uniform in \(n\) concerns token sliding on \(\operatorname{KG}(n,2)\) for \(n\ge5\), with indistinguishable tokens. Finite six-label enumeration is used for the two-token bound; all remaining infinite assertions follow combinatorial proofs. An unindexed equivalent may exist.
title: Sharp freezing and bounded token-sliding distances on \(\operatorname{KG}(n,2)\)
